## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran relevant tests locally.
- [ ] I verified behavior against current OpenSpec change artifacts when applicable.

## Documentation Checklist (Mandatory for behavior changes)

- [ ] I updated README.md for any user-visible or operational behavior change.
- [ ] I updated CHANGELOG.md with exactly one coherent entry for the target version.

## Compatibility Checklist (Mandatory for import/export contract changes)

- [ ] I updated N/N-1 import/export fixtures if payload shape changed.
- [ ] I added or updated unit tests for import/export contract compatibility.
- [ ] I added or updated integration tests for import/export compatibility.
